title: Clark Atlanta University (ClarkAtlanta)

sections.heading: What ClarkAtlanta is known for
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University (ClarkAtlanta) is a private nonprofit institution with an undergraduate enrollment of 3,603 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 64.22%, reflecting a moderately selective admissions process. ClarkAtlanta is particularly known for its business programs, which constitute about 25.32% of its academic offerings.
